goal: Correct production-proven identity observer timeout regression before enabling proxy economy; restore old parallel observer when the DB flag is off; preserve all account identity and cleanup safeguards.
context: Initial code a7b8a64 passed full isolated PostgreSQL and race tests and API review, but real proxy DNS plus TLS exceeded the new 1.5s per-observer timeout, causing identity observation errors while the economy flag was off. Canary admission correctly refused. Retain the original 3s/4s caller deadline for primary observation; use secondary only after early primary failure. Restore the original raced observer whenever economy is off; scope sequential observation to the configured canary. No data rollback, no schema change. A live recovery checkpoint precludes using the generic old-runtime rollback procedure; ship a tested forward correction without discarding recovery work. No subagents. Review exact tested source through API. Then deploy flag off and verify all identities before canary.
commit_message: fix(network): preserve cold identity probe budget and rollback strategy
